bull.probability_evidence: Since September 2026, Incyte has stacked three diversification proof-points (Atebrioz FDA approval with Mirum 2026-09-25, Niktimvo Brazil regulatory approval via Knight Therapeutics 2026-10-06, Specialised Therapeutics' Opzelura partnership expanded 2026-09-20) plus management's post-2029 15-20% CAGR guidance from five late-stage programs (Cantor Fitzgerald conference transcript, 2026-09-10) [factsheet News & sentiment]; the note's section 2 cites this as the basis for pipeline execution offsetting the Jakafi cliff.

target_band.cite: Half the spread between upward-direction valuation anchors each reverting to its OWN 5-year minimum (the only three multiples currently below their 5y min, so able to re-rate up to it): P/E 14.4x→15.1x ≈$118.3, EV/EBITDA 9.6x→11.5x ≈$130.8, P/FCF 12.1x→14.3x ≈$133.3 (factsheet Valuation table, 5y min column; TTM net income/EBITDA/FCF backed out from current multiples and the $23.2bn market cap [ST]); half-spread $7.5 ÷ $133.0 target.

base.probability_evidence: The 10-K names Jakafi/Jakavi single-franchise dependence as a principal risk and the fact sheet gives no Jakafi revenue split to size the step-down (note section 2); the evaluator's rationale treats this inability to measure the cliff's size as the modal, base-rate outcome rather than the bull diversification case or the bear acceleration case.

target_band.cite: Same anchor-disagreement calculation as the bull case (P/E→$118.3, EV/EBITDA→$130.8, P/FCF→$133.3, factsheet Valuation table 5y-min column), since the base case applies the identical 'edges back toward its own floor' logic via P/E alone; half-spread $7.5 ÷ $118.0 target.

bear.probability_evidence: Momentum is weak into the Oct 27, 2026 results (price 8.4% below the 50-day MA, 3-month momentum -2.5%) [factsheet Price], short interest rose 6.6% month-on-month to 5.86% of float, and shares outstanding grew 3.08% YoY from deal funding [factsheet Other] — all cited in the evaluation's bear case as reasons cliff fears could deepen rather than fade.

target_band.cite: Half the spread between downward-direction valuation anchors each reverting to its OWN 5-year minimum (the only two multiples currently ABOVE their 5y min, so able to fall to it): EV/Sales 3.2x→2.7x ≈$98.5, P/B 3.6x→2.7x ≈$84.5 (factsheet Valuation table 5y min column; TTM sales/book value backed out from current multiples and the $23.2bn market cap [ST]); half-spread $7.0 ÷ $95.0 target.

expected_12m_move.cite: mc-inputs.json factor_news.SPY: multiple 2026-10-06 headlines confirm the S&P 500 at record highs (Bloomberg, WSJ, CNBC, Invezz, MarketWatch) and a Goldman Sachs forecast of a further record high before year-end (MarketWatch 'facing rate chaos and narrow breadth... still bullish', 2026-10-06); kept modest because the same headlines flag narrow breadth and overbought megacaps (Barrons, 2026-10-06).

jumps.name: Large earnings-week move
jumps.reason: Quarterly earnings are the single biggest source of one-week volatility in INCY's history, and the next release (Q3 2026, Oct 27, 2026) falls inside the 12-month horizon; the evaluation's bear case flags weak momentum heading into it.
jumps.cite: factsheet Price section 'Next earnings date: Oct 27, 2026 (Est. Earnings)'; evaluation bear case: 'Momentum is weak: the stock sits 8.4% below its 50-day average going into the Oct 27 results.'

annual_probability.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls: only one of the ~20 quarterly earnings_release weeks tagged in event_weeks over the 5-year history (2021-10 to 2026-09) reached this magnitude (-10.55%, week 2023-05-01, tagged 'Q1 2023' earnings_release) — 1-in-5-years ≈ 0.2/yr.

impact.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls / event_weeks: week 2023-05-01 ('Q1 2023' earnings_release), move -0.1055, the largest fall in the 5-year history.

jumps.name: Negative pipeline/regulatory update
jumps.reason: The bull case and the note's valuation section make non-Jakafi pipeline execution (Opzelura, Niktimvo, Atebrioz, five late-stage programs) central to offsetting the Jakafi cliff; the note states 'if pipeline reads out poorly, the discount could still widen', and evaluation trigger #3 names a failure of non-Jakafi products to grow as a thesis-breaking event.
jumps.cite: note section 3 ('if Jakafi erodes earlier than 2028 or pipeline reads out poorly, the discount could still widen'); evaluation trigger: 'Non-Jakafi products...fail to rise as a share of total product revenue over the next four quarters'.
